name: Kurukshetra
sourceReview: Kurukshetra's official district Hindi information-system page evidences local revenue and cadastral-map services. Haryana Web-HALRIS and state/urban GIS routes were inspected. No anonymous safe parcel feature response was verified.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed; official district directory, Web-HALRIS, State GIS and Urban Local Bodies GIS routes found.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: Completed in Hindi; official district page found with Jamabandi and cadastral-map links.
queryReview.geometry: No machine-readable parcel geometry returned; no GeoJSON retained.

requestOutcomes: Official district and Web-HALRIS pages returned HTTP 200. The urban GIS viewer returned HTTP 200 and its current JavaScript was inspected; it presents OTP login and references a WMS plus a POST revenue endpoint whose rendered fields include owner/address/mobile, so that endpoint was not called. WMS capabilities returned 403. The state GIS portal was not queried past the default TLS-verification failure. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: District service references are not proof of a citywide open parcel layer.
No native parcel identity, CRS, or full polygon was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was written.
A login wall, forbidden WMS, skipped unsafe endpoint, or TLS verification failure is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, legal-description, or value fields were requested or retained.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: The official pages evidence a local revenue/map custodian and cadastral-map service references, but not anonymous parcel API access, native schema/CRS, or complete Kurukshetra coverage. No claim is made about parcel absence, ownership, title, tax records, or completeness of Haryana systems.
